_comment: har-policy.default.json -- the stringent scrub baseline (issue #297, Stage 1).
This file is synced from IntelliSDLC.ai and is NOT the place a consuming
project records its own posture: write .har-policy.project.json instead,
which merges over this file and survives the next sync.
RULES ONLY, NEVER VALUES. Names, patterns and decisions live here and are
reviewable in a diff. A raw identity value belongs in the gitignored
The two axes: a `secret` grants access, an `identity` names a person. Every
secret class gates and a consumer may not lower it -- the sanctioned escape
is a per-value `waiver`, which carries a reason and expires. Identity
classes default to `advise` for shape evidence, because shape carries no
provenance: a Luhn-valid digit run is a card, a trip id, or nothing at all.
